snippet.title: Angry Birds Star Wars 2 - out NOW!
snippet.description:
Angry Birds Star Wars 2 is out now! http://rov.io/downloadabsw2

Watch more Angry Birds Star Wars 2 videos at http://rov.io/absw2characters

Angry Birds Star Wars 2 is out now. Price is $0.99 (or local equivalent), and the game will be available on iOS, Android and Windows Phone devices. It is also a universal app, so works across iPhone & iPad!
